name.description: Service name, kebab-case (e.g. `scheduling`, `audit-log`). Becomes apps/<name>, @atlas/<name>, the image atlas/<name>:dev and the k8s Deployment/Service.

db.description: Owns Postgres tables: a pool, migrations that wait for the database within a budget, a readiness check on it, and a transactional outbox store.

broker.description: Talks to JetStream: a NatsBroker that retries rather than crash-loops. With --db, also the outbox relay that publishes what the service commits.

description.description: One sentence for package.json and the README. What the service owns.
